verdict.rationale: Apify's docs directly claim the story's capability: "Share Actors with other people, manage your organizations and permissions" (apify-docs-9). Actors are also described as packaged to be easy to share (apify-docs-13). The support is only a one-line, section-level mention, though, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: detail on role-based permission levels, how organization membership and team management work, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of team sharing.
